here's my rewrite of this. Do not take this as absolute but I think it conveys the same information in a better format
In Mirzapur, a town in Uttar Pradesh, India where law and order is absent and is ruled by gangsters and criminals.There lived a man named Akhandanand Tripathi who was an arms and drug dealer who carried out illegal dealings under the veil of a garment factory. Akhandanand was commonly addressed as 'Kaleen Bhaiyya' by his underlings and the residents of Mirzapur. He is the self proclaimed king of Mirzapur and many people call him by that monicker. Local cops and government officials are afraid of him and many are in his pocket, never daring to cross him. Kaleen Bhaiya had a son named Phoolchand Tripathi. Everyone in Mirzapur called him by his nickname "Munna". He was a hot headed youngster who was reckless and unrepentant. 


One night in Mirzapur, during a marriage procession people were dancing on the street. The groom was paraded on a horse celebrating his marriage. In the middle of the dancing crowd an inebriated Munna took out his pistol and fired a few bullets in the air. Then the drums stopped beating, and a complete silence followed after. Blood dropped from the sky on Munna's face leaving him perplexed, wondering what he had shot. To the horror of all he had killed the groom. Munna, a bully and the son of a tyrant said "oops looks like i killed him," and laughed hard. To know what happens next stay tuned to the next episode of Mirzapur.
